September 3, 2026
Introducing MAI‑Transcribe‑2.
Speaker diarization distinguishes between speakers and attributes words to the right person within a recording
Word‑level timestamps provide precise timing for every word, enabling more accurate alignment, search, navigation, and editing
MAI-Transcribe-2’s powerful capabilities are available to demo today, through Microsoft Foundry, MAI Playground and Open Router.
